findings.detail: A real coordination interface already exists: COORDINATION_CONTRACT.md, coordination_registry.json, coordination_state.json, runtime_manifest.json, plus executions/ and reviews/. It encodes owners (Codex, OpenCode), protected_core_paths, a single active task, and a handoff block with next_actor. It is human/markdown-driven, has NO executable state machine, NO claims/leases, NO quota, NO bounded turn, NO idempotency, NO recovery, NO schema validation.
findings.action: DO NOT DUPLICATE. Loop Control kernel provides the executable layer; governance/coordination remains the canonical human coordination channel. Loop Control MUST NOT create a second coordination_*.json file.

findings.detail: Repo-wide verifier. FORBIDDEN_STATE_PATTERNS bans four reserved coordination tokens in ANY file outside an allowlist: the uppercase current-task marker and the double-quoted JSON forms of handoff, next_actor and current_owner. It also enforces FORBIDDEN_COORD_FILENAMES and flags any filename containing 'coordination' outside governance/coordination. Its rglob excludes .git, .venv, __pycache__, .pytest_cache, .mypy_cache, node_modules, data, 01_Raw, _archive, backup_*, snapshot_*, uploads. It does NOT exclude .loopx/ or engine/ or evidence/.
findings.mitigation: Loop Control state files must not emit those reserved keys in their double-quoted form, nor the current-task marker. Loop Control uses distinct vocabulary: continuation_record, receiving_agent, holding_agent. No Loop Control filename contains 'coordination'.
findings.action: COMPATIBILITY_CONSTRAINT enforced by test.
